3. One Tofazzal Ali Chowdhury created a waqf on 22.11.1915 in respect of 59.945 acres of land appertaining to Jote No. 8 of J.L No.5 of Mouza Sholak Behar, Chittagong by a registered deed of waqf dated 22.11.1915. He then got the said Waqf enlisted in EC No. 2323 in the office of Waqf Administrator. On 10.06.1992, the appellant Motahar Hossain Chowdhury made an application for enlistment of 6.49 acres of land including land of R.S. Plot No.460 of R.S. Khatian No.449 as waqf property. After local enquiry, the Inspector of waqf submitted a report dated 22.09.1992. The said land was also recorded in S.A. and B.S. Khatians as waqf property. On 10.02.1997, one Khorshed Alam filed an application before the Waqf Administrator stating that the said land of C.S. Plot No.609 of C.S. Khatian 202/198 was never made waqf and prayed for a decision in this regard. There was also an enquiry upon an application and the Inspector of waqf submitted his report on 28.02.1997. Accordingly the Waqf Administrator gave his decision dated 12.02.1997 holding that said land of C.S. Plot No.609 was not waqf. 

 4. Against the decision of the Waqf Administrator, the said Md. Yusuf Chowdhury, the petitioner in the civil revision, presented Miscellaneous Appeal No.127 of 1997 under sections 35 and 50 of the Waqf Ordinance 1962 (Ordinance No.1 of 1962) before the District Judge, Chittagong stating, inter alia, that the land of C.S. Plot No.609 of C.S. Khatian No. 202/198 was recorded in R.S. Plot No.460 of R.S. Khatian No.449 as waqf property. Subsequently in S.A. and B.S records of rights, the said land was recorded as waqf property. The appeal was ultimately heard by the learned Additional District. Judge Fourth Court, Chittagong, who dismissed the appeal and affirmed the decision of the Waqf Administrator. 

 7. Mr. Faroque Ahmed, learned Senior Advocate, appearing on behalf of the appellant, submits that the land of R. S. plot No.609 is a waqf property and that the property was recorded as such in the corresponding S. A. and D. S. khatians and that the High Court Division without giving any credence to these khatians held that the land of plot No. 609 was not Waqf. He further submits that on 10.06.1992, one Mothar Hossain Chowdhury made an application for enlistment of 6.49 acres of land including the land of K.S. khatian No.449 and that after local inquiry, the inspector of waqf submitted a report dated 22.09.1992 stating that the disputed land was, in fact, made waqf he lastly submits that the deed of waqf dated 22.01.1915 contains R. S. plot No. 460 of R: S. khatian No. 449 of Mouza Sholak Bahar in plot No. 14 and accordingly enrollment was made and that the High Court Division fell in error in deciding otherwise. 

 I. The land of C. S. Khatian No.449 of Mouza Sholak Bahar, District-Chittagong was recorded as waqf property represented by Waqif Mutwalli Tofazzal Ali Chowdhury and in the subsequent P. S. and B. S. record he said property was recorded as waqf property. Therefore, the High Court Division was in error in finding that the Waqif did not endow the same land as waqf. 

 II. The waqf deed dated 22.01.1915 contains the land of R. S plot No. 460 of R. S. Khatian No. 449 of Mouza Sholak Bahar in plot No. 14 and upon local inquiry by the Inspector of Waqfs the same was found to be the waqf property and enrolled as waqf property but the High Court Division fell in error in deciding otherwise. 

 11. On 22.11.1915, one Tofazzal Ali Chowdhury created a waqf in respect of 59.945 acres of land appertaining to Jote No. 8 of J.L. No. 5 by a registered deed of waqf. Subsequently, he got the said waqf enlisted in E. C. No.2323 according to the Bengal Wakfs Act, 1934 in the then office of Waqf Administrator. On 10.06.1992, the appellant of F.M.A. No. 228 of 2000 made an application for enlistment of 6.49 acres of land of R. S. plot No. 460 of R. S. khatian No.449 as waqf property. After local investigation, the Inspector submitted a report on 22.09.1992 stating that the land was also recorded in S. A. and B. S. khatians as waqf property. On 10.02.1997, one Khorshed Alam made an application before the Waqf Administrator stating that the land appertaining to C. S. plot No. 609 corresponding to C. S. khatian Nos. 202/198 was never made waqf and that he prayed for a decision of Wall Administrator in this regard. Upon an application, there was an inquiry and the Inspector of waqf submitted a reported dated 28.02.1997 stating that the disputed land was not made waqf. Considering the report and the record, the Waqf Administrator gave his decision on 12.02.1997 holding that the land of C. S. plot No. 609 was never made waqf.
